key_points: AI-powered fintech solution designed for stock market investors.
Generates actionable recommendations based on comprehensive data analysis.
Utilizes advanced algorithms to enhance stock selection and portfolio management.
Real-time performance monitoring dashboard for backend tasks.
Insight generation from news articles using small language models (SLMs).
Portfolio expansion capabilities aligned with stock picking strategies.
Mutual fund investment composition display for asset allocation analysis.
Historical performance review and backtesting for informed decision-making.
Insights derived from company reports, including shareholding patterns and cash flow.
Identify top gainers and losers with the 'What's Trending' feature.
Track daily price movements and significant corporate actions.
Diversify portfolios with superior returns while minimizing risk.
Continuous integration of new companies into the Algofabric ecosystem.
Performance comparison and optimization of SLMs versus LLMs.
Expansion of business use cases to address real-life investment challenges.
